mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% and the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.8%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases and the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances and the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205.0), the Federal Reserve's policy tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) increases discount rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 205.0 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases and the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0 and the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 135,000 thousand signals weak labor market growth, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS falls below 135,000, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases and the Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate severe economic slowdown, triggering prolonged earnings pressure and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases and the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During disinflationary periods (CPIAUCSL < 200.0), accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) supports stable growth and low discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is below 200.0 and FEDFUNDS is below 4.5, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases and the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
